title: The public server is back, with a fresh start.
summary: The online world was rebuilt with a new database. Create your account on this site and download launcher v78 to play.
changes: New server and new database: accounts from the old server no longer exist, so please register again.
Account sign-up and My account work again on this site.
Launcher v78 connects to the new server and keeps the client updated automatically.
The game database is backed up every day.
paragraphs: Open Create account, choose your account number, character and password, then download launcher v78 on the same page. Extract it and open AntigasLauncher.exe.
Questions, bugs or ideas? Join the community on Discord: discord.gg/CVneyh53mZ

title: Friendlier NPCs, the original 7.4 map and a lighter client.
summary: Talking and trading with NPCs is easier, the world is back to the original 7.4 map, and the client is lighter and smoother to play.
changes: New NPC trade window: say hi, then trade, and pick items in a grid.
A chat balloon above NPCs: click it to say hi.
Right-clicking an NPC now greets it instead of attacking.
NPCs have a blue health bar, so they stand out from monsters.
Drinking water gives +1 mana every 10 seconds for 1 hour.
The map is back to the original 7.4: trainers, Yalahar, custom islands, the arena and horses were removed.
New minimap with markers for temples, banks, shops, quests and stairs.
The client now comes only in the OpenGL version (Antigas_gl.exe); the DirectX version was removed.
Widescreen fix and smoother walking when your ping is high.
The Discord button in the client opens our new community server.
paragraphs: These changes are in launcher v78 for the public server and in the localhost package local-test-v2.
Coming soon: a Game Wiki book inside the client, with Bestiary, Itempedia and a Hunting Guide.

title: Server and Windows client, ready for localhost.
summary: Download the complete package to explore Rookgaard and test your own changes in a separate local world.
changes: Server, test database and Windows .exe client in one package.
Tibia74-Local.exe prepares the world and opens the game; closing the game preserves its progress.
Normal demo account: 2 / local123, character Local Adventurer.
paragraphs: Requires Docker Desktop with Linux containers and internet for the first setup. The Windows client is already included.
Build, login, map entry, client movement and saved position after restart were validated. This is a test release; not every quest or game system has been fully tested.

title: Tibia 7.4 — A classic rpg version.
summary: Previously Antigas, the project now shares its code, development story and credits with the community on GitHub.
changes: New project name and public source repository.
README with the story behind the server and paths for players and contributors.
Original copyright notices and third-party licenses preserved.
paragraphs: The server was born from a dream of sharing adventures, exploration and good memories with the community. The project continues to evolve with its players and contributors.

This is an independent project with custom systems, inspired by Tibia. Credits include Alejandro Mujica, the OpenTibia and OTClient communities, and rxi. Tibia was created by CipSoft; this project is not affiliated with it.
